scripts.build:react: npm run build:core && npm run build:styles && npm run build -w @akin2unde/flowui-react
scripts.build:angular: npm run build:core && npm run build:styles && npm run build -w @akin2unde/flowui-angular
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:core && npm run build:styles && npm run build -w @akin2unde/flowui-react && npm run build -w @akin2unde/flowui-angular
scripts.build:examples: npm run build -w @akin2unde/flowui-react-example && npm run build -w @akin2unde/flowui-angular-example
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:examples
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @akin2unde/flowui-core && npm run typecheck -w @akin2unde/flowui-react && npm run typecheck -w @akin2unde/flowui-angular
scripts.test: npm run test -w @akin2unde/flowui-core && npm run test -w @akin2unde/flowui-react
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run format:check
scripts.publish:packages: npm publish -w @akin2unde/flowui-core --access public && npm publish -w @akin2unde/flowui-react --access public && npm publish -w @akin2unde/flowui-angular --access public
